scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag can only lead to a proposal of a NEW preregistered forward window, which needs the user's explicit go.

universe.rule: exactly ADR 0047: every USDT-quoted symbol of the public Binance USDT-M archive incl. delisted; at rebalance day i cut-off = bar i-2; eligible = >=60 daily bars, open at day i, 30-day mean quote volume v30 >= 2,000,000 USDT; ranked by v30 desc, ties by name
universe.segment_rule: BTCUSDT is not read in S2; every symbol obeys never_read

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported, and used only in the fixed S2 > 0.5 condition

segments.metrics_family_S1_start: metrics archive starts 2021-12-01 for most symbols; M hypotheses are evaluated in S1 from 2022-01-03 (the first 28-day grid day whose cut-28 is >= 2021-12-01), about 1.71 years

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols
rebalance: every 28 days on the grid; signal at cut-off bar i-2; trade at the open of day i; weights drift between rebalances; trade |target - drifted| at each rebalance (ADR 0040/0047 convention); real settled funding applied

hypotheses.weights: +1/n for each of the n U50 names with signal > 0, 0 otherwise (n = names with a finite signal); gross <= 1, long or cash

hypotheses.economics: leverage crowding unwinds: names whose open interest (coin units) grew most get sold
hypotheses.signal: ln(OI_coins(cut) / OI_coins(cut-28)); OI_coins(day) = last 5-minute sum_open_interest of that UTC day
hypotheses.selection: quintile long-short, K = floor(n/5) per side, equal weight 1/(2K)

hypotheses.signal: mean of count_long_short_ratio over the 7 days cut-6..cut (day value = mean of its 5-minute rows; >= 6 of 7 days required)
mean over the 7 days of ln(sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio) - ln(count_long_short_ratio) (>= 6 of 7 days)

missing_data_rule: a name without a finite signal is left out of that rebalance; if fewer than 2K names (or, for L, none) have a signal the book is flat until the next rebalance and the skip is counted. Missing return days count as 0 and are counted.

cost.decides: ADR 0041 volume-scaled low-liquidity calibration ('cal', ESTIMATED from measured public order books), as ADR 0047
reported_and_in_conditions: cal_tail_x2 (x2 only on names thinner than the thinnest measured book)

flag_rule: DEV_PROMISING only if all hold on the hypothesis' own evaluation span: S1 'cal' annual SR > expected max SR of 8 unskilled trials at that span length; beta-adjusted alpha t >= 2 (vs the equal-weight universe); both S1 halves > 0; S2 'cal' SR > 0.5; S1 cal_x2 > 0 and cal_tail_x2 > 0. Otherwise NOT_PROMISING.
multiple_testing: 8 trials appended to run/audit/dev_search_trials.jsonl (context U50W200-28d-lowfreq-nonprice-v1). Reported: null max SR at N=8 and at the cumulative N; DSR (Bailey-Lopez de Prado, engine_lib.deflated_sharpe) at N=8 and cumulative N with the cross-trial SR variance of these 8; PBO (engine_lib.pbo_cscv, 16 partitions) over the 8 S1 'cal' daily series on their common span (2022-01-03..2023-09-18). Report only, no gate change.
power_note_written_before_results: With 28-day rebalancing there are only about 33 (L, S1) or 22 (M, S1) rebalance decisions; the 80% minimum detectable annual SR at Bonferroni 0.05/8 is about 2.1 (2.55 years) and about 2.6 (1.71 years). Directional returns of alts carry about 1.6 independent bets (ADR 0059), so L1/L2 are weak tests by construction. A NOT_PROMISING result here does NOT show the effect is absent.
benchmark_reported_not_counted: U50 equal-weight buy-and-hold rebalanced on the same grid (B0), cost 'cal'
